name: Upchuck
abilities: Three (or four) long adhesive prehensile tongues
Mouth expansion - swallows objects larger than himself
Eats almost any matter, liquid or energy (Sub-Energy, energy beams)
Converts what he eats into explosive green vomit 'loogies'
weaknesses: Size limit - To'kustar-sized things must be chopped up first
Too much matter/energy inflates him and kills his mobility
Struggles to keep down living, moving prey
In OS could not eat normal human food
summary: Ben's bottomless-stomach Gourmand who eats anything - even raw energy - and spits it back as explosive loogies; Perk in OS, Murk in AF/UA, both in OV.
traits: Perk (green, curly tail) vs Murk (swamp-green, spotted, straight tail) sub-species
Stomach links to a trans-space bladder dimension
Gourmands ate their own planet Peptos XI to deny it to the Incurseans
notableFeats: Ate the Sub-Energy and defeated the Mechadroid (The Visitor)
Defeated the Red Knight and Sir Driscoll, blowing up Mt. Rushmore (Ben 10 vs. Negative 10: Part 2)
Ate a Crabdozer whole (For a Few Brains More)
Captured the escaped Chromastone (Vengeance of Vilgax: Part 2)
Ate Charmcaster's giant animated Mr. Smoothy (In Charm's Way)
Carried the Alpha Nanite's container across dimensions in his stomach (Heroes United)

appearances.designNotes: PERK Gourmand: green skin, six sprouts on the head, dark-green head patch, crooked overbite, curled tail, white eyes; black open-front suit with white over-sleeves and leg bands, original Omnitrix on the left hand.

MURK Gourmand: swamp-green skin with tan stomach and muzzle, black sprouts and black-green spots, sharp green eyes, whisker lines, aligned teeth with canines, short straight tail, no clothing, Omnitrix on the stomach (shared AF/UA design).
MURK Gourmand, same as Alien Force with the Ultimatrix on the stomach; Heroes United version has longer face stripes and finger stubs.

Both variants appear (Tummy Trouble). PERK (most used, chosen image): 16-year-old is unclothed with green eyes and Omnitrix on the stomach; 11-year-old keeps the OS suit with green eyes, green Omnitrix and bare clawed feet. MURK (Store 23, Tummy Trouble): previous design with longer claws, brighter sprouts, fewer spots, two underbite teeth. Murk image: 'Murk Upchuck Stand.png'.

scoring.rationale: Eating anything up to raw energy and returning it as grenade-strength explosive loogies is a strong, flexible offense/counter, and he can fly on vomit and survive space. Physically small and slow, easily bloated or distracted by food.

notes: Variant by series: OS = Perk; AF/UA = Murk (Perk locked in Ben 10 Returns, Murk unlocked by the Master Control in War of the Worlds: Part 1); OV = both, mostly Perk.
AF: War of the Worlds: Part 1 is wiki S1 (Ben 15); Vengeance of Vilgax: Part 2 and In Charm's Way are wiki S2 (Ben 16).
UA 'Duped' use is by 'Rude Ben' (a personality-split Ben) - counted as Ben. Also used by Gwen (Inspector 13) and Mad Ben (OV) - not counted.
One alien record for both variants per assignment; per-series designNotes describe which variant.
